verdict.rationale: Evidence shows scheduled ISR regeneration ('Regenerate static pages on a schedule or on demand') and a Workflow SDK for durable, retryable, resumable multi-step logic, which together provide some building blocks for recurring automation, but there's no explicit documentation of a general-purpose cron/job-scheduler feature for arbitrary recurring workflows triggered on a time-based schedule outside of ISR regeneration. Missing for 10: a documented dedicated cron/scheduled-jobs feature, explicit recurring-trigger configuration for Workflows, and independent confirmation that AI-native users can set up arbitrary recurring automation beyond static-page regeneration.
